breadcrumb.label: Internship registration and validation with Mobility Online

blocks.html:
Before registering the internship

To be recognized as a curricular internship, the internship must be included in the study plan, comply with the guidelines and requirements, and be approved by the Academic Tutor of the program through the Mobility Online platform.

If even one of these conditions is not met, the internship will be considered extracurricular. Information to register extracurricular internships is available at the bottom of the page.

Login – Access to the Platform

First Login

Log in to Mobility Online using your SWITCH edu-ID credentials via this link: Mobility Online Login

  • Fill out the registration form (mandatory fields are marked with *)
  • After submission, you will receive an automatic email with the subject "Confirmation of registration"

Do NOT delete this email, the link it contains will always be required to access the platform.

Logins After Registration

Click on the link received by email and log in using the number that is automatically entered, no password required

  • You will then be redirected to login via SWITCH edu-ID

Registration – Pre-Internship

  1. Fill in the internship registration form on Mobility Online (First Login)
  2. Complete all required information in the Mobility Online Workflow via the link received by email
  3. The Academic Tutor approves the internship directly on Mobility Online
  4. Upload in the Workflow a copy of the internship contract or the internship agreement:

ONLY one of the two documents is required. Do not upload both.

NB: the internship agreement is not mandatory if you already have a valid contract provided by the company.​

  • If needed, you may request in the Workflow the letter for the Migration Office (internship in CH)

- It will be issued only if documents are complete and requested 2 weeks before the start of the internship

Validation – Post-Internship

  1. Confirm the dates and upload the following documents in the Workflow:

- End of Internship Certificate – issued by the host organization

- Updated CV – including the internship experience to be validated

- Feedback Form – completed and signed by the Company Tutor

  1. Complete the Final Report of the internship in the Workflow and wait for approval by the Academic Tutor

items.title: Extracurricular internship registration
items.html:
It is necessary to register an extracurricular internship on Mobility Online only for one or more of the following reasons:

  • Internship abroad
    • Obtain the internship agreement signed by the university (NB: the agreement is not mandatory if you already have a valid contract provided by the company)
    • Apply for the SEMP grant for internships abroad: if the requirements are met, you will be able to download the necessary documents to obtain the grant
  • Internship in Switzerland
    • Request the internship certification letter to be submitted to the Migration Office

items.title: Indicazioni Generali - Mobility Online
items.html:
• All document templates are available in the Workflow and at the following link: Documents for the internship
  • Students receive automatic emails:

- When new steps become available in the Workflow

- If documents or information are incorrect or invalid

​

The Career Service is responsible for verifying the documentation, validating the internship and assigning ECTS credits.

For any further information, please contact: careerservice@usi.ch
